plugins.name: stack-diff-doc
plugins.description: Create stack-diff planning docs (issue-<slug>.md) for a stacked-diff workflow: issue title/body, branch slug, and a git-spice-ready commit message.

plugins.name: lean-prose
plugins.description: House prose style: lean, plainly worded text for documentation, commit messages, pull/merge request descriptions, issue bodies, and comments.

plugins.name: work-item-briefs
plugins.description: Write the two higher-altitude descriptions of a whole piece of work — an epic brief (brief technical) and a business brief (business level) — as markdown files, above the per-diff stack-diff docs.

plugins.name: markup-style
plugins.description: House markup conventions for prose: backtick code identifiers and repository/module/package names.

plugins.name: go-style
plugins.description: House Go style rules: interface placement, error handling, doc comments, struct field comments, testing conventions, and more.

plugins.name: british-english
plugins.description: House spelling convention: British English everywhere, including code identifiers.

plugins.name: doc-conventions
plugins.description: House document conventions: ADR title/status format, working-note Lifespan lines, the specification/implementation-notes document set for a piece of work, and relocating a document between repositories.

plugins.name: grill-with-docs
plugins.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, producing the specification, ADRs, glossary entries, and implementation notes as we go. Bundles the grilling and domain-modeling skills it drives, and to-issues for breaking a specification into end-to-end vertical-slice issues.
